column1: # Spanish (es) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#                                 the language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Spanish computing vocabulary (capa, pincel, selección, lienzo ...). No proprietary localisation
# resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product and technology names (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, OpenType, CMYK, Lab ...) stay in Latin
# letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
# Layer Mask Display Options (the layer mask rubylith's colour and opacity)
# Channel Options and New Spot Channel (#3761)
# Tool names, brush and style option tables
# Preferences (labels are generated from the setting names)
# Added with the rebase onto the dock / brush picker work
# Strings added to the UI after this catalog was first written (rebase onto main, 2026-10).
# Gradient Editor window, opened from the options bar's gradient swatch.
# Tool, filter, warp-style, path, layer-comp and metadata names that fell outside the `tl!` test.
# Spanish follows the tool wording used above (Herramienta X).
# Command-id override: under Edit > Purge a bare "Deshacer" reads as an action, not the history.
# Camera Raw: contextual controls and window title
# Shared screen eyedropper and text Color Picker (#1128).
# Fill dialog, layer style contours and Image Size
# File Info ▸ Camera Data (read-only EXIF fields; "Make" is the camera maker, not the verb).
# Add Noise, Reduce Noise and Smart Sharpen dialog controls (Filter > Noise, Filter > Sharpen).
# Select and Mask Refine Edge Brush (#2972)
# Color Sampler (added with the i18n coverage repair)
# Counted status messages and labels (#3454; adapted from PR #3821)
# Dynamic labels (filter and adjustment parameters, Camera Raw, panels, dialogs) that the
# Path, channel, layer style, status and System Info labels the Czech catalog added
# Actions panel: Load/Save Actions (.atn) and kept Photoshop steps
# Actions panel: set folders, dialog toggle, Insert Stop
# Embedded Profile Mismatch: profile names beside the choices, Remember this choice
# Export As metadata and profile options
# Free Transform: a new layer while the box is open (#5859)
# Preferences › Performance › GPU Memory; the status bar and slow-redraw notice
# Actions: a step dialog holds a suspended recording (#7365)
# Color panel menu: modes, copy commands and colour ramps (#6000)
# Pen draft after a refused commit (#7648)
